payload.title: Persona ZetaId must be structurally unresolvable to a process: persona = what remains (owner/supervisor, never an actor); cell occupancy = what acts. Evidence the ambiguity is already live and broken: plist com.lucent.zeta.otto has Label=otto but ProgramArguments=tools/kiro/kiro-loop-wrapper.sh and ZETA_KIRO_LOOP_* env, while persona-registry.ts declares otto's label as com.lucent.zeta.otto-loop which does not exist on the machine. Persona-scoped keys reachable only under the persona target kind.
